interpretation: Finish the required complete native Main renderer/provider/support/whole-view integration and accurate ownership/resource admission for P05. Keep public continuous travel UI in P06, binding-aware session/export/retirement recovery in P07, and full conformance/quiet timing/native peaks/final delivery in P08. Tests may be performed early when they are useful, but do not silently grow P05 into all remaining Phase One exits.
